entities.summary: George Campbell Munro was a New Zealand born pioneer of Hawaiian botany and ornithology. He settled on a ranch in Lanai and wrote one of the first books on the birds of Hawaii, many species of which are now extinct. The plant genus Munroidendron and the extinct Lanai finch Dysmorodrepanis munroi are named after him.
